response.body:
{
  "statements": [
    "CREATE SCHEMA dbimp_t_sch",
    "CREATE SEQUENCE dbimp_t_seq OPTIONS (
  sequence_kind = 'bit_reversed_positive'
)",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_big (
  id INT64 NOT NULL,
  v STRING(MAX),
  y BYTES(MAX),
) PRIMARY KEY(id)",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_dml (
  id INT64 NOT NULL,
  s STRING(MAX),
  n INT64,
  extra2 INT64,
  cts TIMESTAMP OPTIONS (
    allow_commit_timestamp = true
  ),
) PRIMARY KEY(id)",
    "CREATE NULL_FILTERED INDEX dbimp_t_idx_nf ON dbimp_t_dml(n) STORING (s)",
    "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dbimp_t_idx_u ON dbimp_t_dml(s)",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_doc (
  id INT64 NOT NULL,
  body STRING(MAX),
  body_tokens TOKENLIST AS (TOKENIZE_FULLTEXT(body)) HIDDEN,
) PRIMARY KEY(id)",
    "CREATE SEARCH INDEX dbimp_t_si ON dbimp_t_doc(body_tokens)",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_fk (
  id INT64 NOT NULL,
  pid INT64,
  g INT64 AS (id * 2) STORED,
  d STRING(MAX) DEFAULT ('x'),
  CONSTRAINT dbimp_t_chk CHECK(id > 0),
) PRIMARY KEY(id)",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_many (
  id INT64 NOT NULL,
  g INT64,
  pad STRING(100),
) PRIMARY KEY(id)",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_par (
  pid INT64 NOT NULL,
  name STRING(100),
) PRIMARY KEY(pid)",
    "ALTER TABLE dbimp_t_fk ADD CONSTRAINT dbimp_t_fk_par FOREIGN KEY(pid) REFERENCES dbimp_t_par(pid)",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_chi (
  pid INT64 NOT NULL,
  cid INT64 NOT NULL,
  v STRING(MAX),
) PRIMARY KEY(pid, cid),
  INTERLEAVE IN PARENT dbimp_t_par ON DELETE CASCADE",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_sch.t1 (
  id INT64 NOT NULL,
  s STRING(MAX),
) PRIMARY KEY(id)",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_seqtab (
  id INT64 DEFAULT (GET_NEXT_SEQUENCE_VALUE(SEQUENCE dbimp_t_seq)),
  v STRING(MAX),
) PRIMARY KEY(id)",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_ttl (
  id INT64 NOT NULL,
  ts TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY(id), ROW DELETION POLICY (OLDER_THAN(ts, INTERVAL 30 DAY))",
    "CREATE TABLE dbimp_t_types (
  id INT64 NOT NULL,
  i64 INT64,
  f64 FLOAT64,
  f32 FLOAT32,
  n NUMERIC,
  b BOOL,
  s STRING(MAX),
  y BYTES(MAX),
  d DATE,
  ts TIMESTAMP,
  j JSON,
  arr_i ARRAY<INT64>,
  arr_s ARRAY<STRING(MAX)>,
  arr_f ARRAY<FLOAT64>,
  arr_n ARRAY<NUMERIC>,
  arr_b ARRAY<BOOL>,
  arr_y ARRAY<BYTES(MAX)>,
  arr_d ARRAY<DATE>,
  arr_ts ARRAY<TIMESTAMP>,
  arr_j ARRAY<JSON>,
  u UUID,
) PRIMARY KEY(id)",
    "CREATE CHANGE STREAM dbimp_t_cs
  FOR dbimp_t_dml",
    "CREATE VIEW dbimp_t_v SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT t.id AS id, t.s AS s FROM dbimp_t_dml t"
  ]
}
